loader.why: Codi rHB 2 (variants): the same three source files feed ten other pages (NavCards, PageHeader images, NOS hero photos, ticket cards) through the same variant names, so re-encoding them in place at q88 would move every other image off 75. The hero's quality prop instead selects a separate -q88 set; every request without a quality prop maps to the BASE name, byte-identical.

css.why: Codi rHB 3. Veil >=768: Codi's exact stops. Veil <768: Codi's desktop tail mapped proportionally onto the mobile shoulder (70%, 0.86): position = 70 + 30 x (p - 62) / 38, alpha = 0.86 x a / 0.84, positions rounded to whole percent, alphas to 2 decimals (74 -> 79.47 -> 79%, 0.62 -> 0.635 -> 0.63; 86 -> 88.95 -> 89%, 0.34 -> 0.348 -> 0.35; 94 -> 95.26 -> 95%, 0.12 -> 0.123 -> 0.12). Pull: Codi's stops, but on --parchment (#f4f3ec = rgb 244 243 236), not --bone: MissionBlock's section is bg-parchment (components/home/MissionBlock.tsx:42), so a bone pull ends 12-16 levels off the next section (the seam). The diagonal is unchanged; no dither or noise layer. AMENDED (Codi, 2026-10-22, on the architect's risk): Codi's first stop (0.2 at 56px -> 0 at 72px) began at 0.0125/px against BASE's 0.0139/px, so the line at the pull's top survived at ~90%. Above 56px the pull is now a quadratic ease-in, alpha(u) = 0.2 x (u/28)^2 with u = 84px - d, sampled every 4px and rounded to whole 1/255 steps (37, 26, 17, 9, 4, 1, 0 of 255), because Chrome keeps a stop's alpha in 8 bits: finer 4-decimal stops render unevenly. In 1/255-per-px units (BASE's join kink is 255/72 = 3.54): the slope above the top is 0 and the first chord 0.25 (7.1% of BASE), the joints change it by 0.5, 0.5, 0.75, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 (14-21%, all below Codi's own accepted 16px joint at 34%), and the last chord (3.5) meets Codi's 36-56px segment (3.825) within 0.325 (9.2%). Codi's stops at 0-56px are unchanged; the pull now reaches 84px, inside the section's 96px bottom padding.
